refnamediv.refpurpose: Unwrap radian phases in an input array.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: retval = unwrap2(x) retval = unwrap2(x, tol) retval = unwrap2(x, tol, dim)

listitem.para: Input array containing radian phases to be unwrapped.
Tolerance parameter specifying the maximum jump allowed between consecutive phases before adding or subtracting 2π. Defaults to π.
Dimension along which to unwrap the phases. If unspecified, dim defaults to the first non-singleton dimension of the array x.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `unwrap2` function adjusts radian phases in the input array `x` by adding or subtracting multiples of 2π as necessary to remove phase jumps that exceed the specified tolerance `tol`. If `tol` is not provided, it defaults to π. The function operates along the specified dimension `dim` or the first non-singleton dimension if `dim` is not provided.
